name: Slow Cooker Korean Galbi Jjim (Braised Short Ribs)
ingredients_verbatim: 2 large carrots, chopped in 2 inch pieces
1 medium turnip, cut in one inch pieces
why: Distinctive Korean braise absent from the catalog (no galbi jjim). Published nutrition sits mid-band at 481 cal / 22g carbs / 44g protein per serving. Pure slow-cooker dump-and-go, scales cleanly to 14 servings by multiplying the short ribs and sauce. Signature cut (beef short ribs) has no board home plus several other absent ingredients (gochugaru, tteok rice cakes, turnip, pear) - a strong pricer-lane stress test. Verified: nutrition and full ingredient list read directly from the recipe card.
